description: This file defines functions and constants for managing service environment configurations, including path resolution, environment variable handling, and service-specific environment setup for Node.js and gateway services.

methods.name: readServiceProxyEnvironment
methods.description: Filters environment variables to include only proxy-related keys with non-empty string values.

methods.name: addNonEmptyDir
methods.description: Adds a directory to the list if it is defined.

methods.name: appendSubdir
methods.description: Appends a subdirectory to a base path if not already present.

methods.name: addCommonUserBinDirs
methods.description: Adds common user bin directories based on the home directory.

methods.name: addCommonEnvConfiguredBinDirs
methods.description: Adds environment-configured binary directories based on environment variables.

methods.name: resolveSystemPathDirs
methods.description: Returns system PATH directories based on platform.

methods.name: resolveDarwinUserBinDirs
methods.description: Resolves user bin directories for macOS, including paths for version managers.

methods.name: resolveLinuxUserBinDirs
methods.description: Resolves user bin directories for Linux, including paths for version managers.

methods.name: getMinimalServicePathParts
methods.description: Generates an ordered list of directories for minimal service PATH based on platform and environment.

methods.name: getMinimalServicePathPartsFromEnv
methods.description: Generates PATH parts from environment variables.

methods.name: buildMinimalServicePath
methods.description: Builds a PATH string from directory parts for the service environment.

methods.name: buildServiceEnvironment
methods.description: Constructs environment variables for a service, including port, labels, and systemd/unit names.

methods.name: buildNodeServiceEnvironment
methods.description: Constructs environment variables specific to Node.js services.

methods.name: buildCommonServiceEnvironment
methods.description: Creates common environment variables shared between service types.

methods.name: resolveSharedServiceEnvironmentFields
methods.description: Resolves shared environment fields like temp directory, proxy env, and CA certs based on platform and environment.
